title: Quick Smoky Canadian Chicken Legs Skewers
description: A quick and flavorful Canadian dish featuring chicken legs, smoke, and dairy-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is easy to make and packed with smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the smoky mixture.
Thread the chicken legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each leg.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the wood chips for smoking by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
After 15 minutes of cooking, add the wood chips to the grill and close the lid to allow the chicken to absorb the smoky flavor.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the smoky chicken legs hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
